chunks: Sama'ah narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
It is not proper to drink from vessels of silver and gold.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, the Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.سَمَاعَةُ: Sama'ah, the transmitter of the hadith
key_terms.لَا يَنْبَغِي: it is not proper; indicates disapproval or prohibition in context

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to drink from gold and silver vessels in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states that drinking from utensils made of silver and gold is improper. It conveys a legal-ethical discouragement regarding the use of luxurious vessels in eating and drinking etiquette.
